policies.name: visible-gasket-0.0000
policies.interpretation: This policy explicitly finds the visible target line and aims at a fixed fraction. Expected rate enumerates the actual source-offset problem pool; do not compare it to an unconditioned 4.444% angle guess. Uniform destination along the whole 198 px line has a separate conditional angular window approximately 2 × gap × tan(4°) / 198; this fixed-fraction policy is not uniform.
